<timestamp>Monday, Jul 20, 2026, 6:54 AM (UTC+7)</timestamp>
<user_query>
Explore the codebase at g:\0.0.0.Dashboard\cd-21 to understand how the Main/School dashboard ("Tổng quan hệ thống" / RightPageMainDashboard) loads filter data and dashboard data.

Focus on:
1. hisa/assetsDashboard/js/pages/school-dashboard.init.js - how filters work (year, semester, faculty, course), API calls, params sent
2. Any API ashx related to school/main dashboard
3. Any SQL stored procedures for main/school dashboard (look in sql/ folder for DASH_* related to overview/main/school)
4. How StudentClassSize dashboard filter works (API + JS for science/course/class + fromDate/toDate) as reference

Return:
- File paths of relevant API, DAL/BLL, SQL
- Current filter parameters for main dashboard
- How StudentClassSize sends ScienceID, CourseID, ClassID, FromDate, ToDate
- Whether main dashboard already has SP that supports date filtering or only year/semester
- Key code snippets showing API parameter names and SP names

Be thorough (medium).
</user_query>
I'll map how the Main/School dashboard and StudentClassSize load filters and data—starting with the JS init files, then tracing APIs and SQL.

input.final_summary: Main dashboard filters by yearId/semester/scienceId/courseId via HomeDashboardApi → DASH_MainSummary_GetData / DASH_Overview_GetFilter; no FromDate/ToDate. StudentClassSize sends scienceId/courseId/classId/fromDate/toDate to DASH_StudentClassSize_GetData.
